rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a home tank used to keep fish or other aquatic animals.

example.english: I keep several goldfish in the aquarium at home.
example.traditional: 我屋企個魚缸入面養咗幾條金魚。
example.jyutping: ngo5 uk1 kei2 go3 jyu4 gong1 jap6 min6 joeng5 zo2 gei2 tiu4 gam1 jyu4

rows.note: Use this for a public facility where visitors go to see exhibited fish and other aquatic animals.

example.english: Children love going to the aquarium to see sharks.
example.traditional: 細路仔最鍾意去水族館睇鯊魚。
example.jyutping: sai3 lou6 zai2 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 heoi3 seoi2 zuk6 gun2 tai2 saa1 jyu4
